semanticGuards: Due-in count describes when the deadline falls. It is not permission to wait until after it and adds no start interval. TS candidate “ku nga si hela masiku ya {count}” means before {count} days have elapsed; official Xitsonga source supports the temporal construction only.
Overdue remains past-tense and distinct from future due-in. Date interpolation is unchanged; English source companion uses English date formatting.
Finish applies when the previous module is incomplete; Submit applies when the module is complete but its assignment is not submitted. Preserve {title} exactly once.
Mentor override remains “Opened by your mentor.”
Practitioner remains an ordinary person-practicing-method label; it does not imply expert status or certification.
Ya ntolovelo is contextual “usual/standard preset”, not a quality guarantee.
